;; D19 demonstration, AFTER: the same four-ghost eastward step with
;; capture variables and register-carried floors.  One character per
;; ghost; the floor underneath lives behind its !N register; variable j
;; is the carried floor and v the floor being stepped onto.

GOAL
Z

CLASS floor -.o

B.-P.oIo-K---
%(e)e[e]e----
%!1.!2-!3o!4-

BIND g move_all "step all ghosts east"

CMD move_all
 TRY_ALL
  ZIP M ()[] G BPIK N 1234
   ATOMIC j floor v floor
    Me

    !Nj

    Gv jG

    !Nj !Nv
